# Problem brief: agents bypass planning alternatives

## Problem statement

Solution-bearing FRs are planned from whatever the author's loaded
context resembles; the house framework is never proposed.

## Classification

judgement/analysis/generation

## Constraints

- No daemon; a blocking run measured in minutes.

## Witnessed incidents

- 2026-08-25: a 13-AC enumerative grammar shipped without OS permissions
  ever being considered.

## Proposed Solution

Write a 601-line bash guard that parses every terminal write shape with
a regex grammar.

## Candidates

- Candidate: pre-commit hook written in bash
- Candidate: regex grammar over terminal commands
